item.title: I’ve decided motherhood is not for me. But being an auntie? It’s what I was born to do
item.summary: I’m a backup caregiver, a teller of stories, a giver of snacks. Also, kids ask too many questions for their parents to answer them all “She doesn’t have kids!” My littlest niece, Bonnie, said to my sister one day, about me. “That’s why she has so much time to love you,” my sister said. Bonnie did some deep, earnest thinking, as toddlers do when they’re really considering something. Then she nodded, as if to say: yes, that is an extremely valid choice. If only everyone understood so easily. Continue reading...
